channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Seth Curry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Seth Curry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Seth Curry
item.description:
The mistake was magnified after the buzzer when Warriors forward Draymond Green, in a long back-and-forth about the NBA's tanking epidemic, insinuated the Kings had done it for the purposes of losing the game.

“I saw a team tonight foul Seth Curry with three minutes to go for no reason,”

Draymond Green on Seth Curry, Apr 8, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on James Harden, Seth Curry, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Nets'Kevin Durant on integrating Ben Simmons, Seth Curry & new pieces after James Harden trade on TNT:

“I feel like we've got versatile players. We'll have to figure it out and figure out what works for us. I'm just happy we've got guys who want to be a part of this.”

Kevin Durant on James Harden, Seth Curry, Ben Simmons, Feb 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Josh Richardson on Seth Curry
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Richardson on trading places with Seth Curry:

“I think me coming here and him going there is good for both parties.”

Josh Richardson on Seth Curry, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Seth Curry
item.description:
Sixers coach Doc Rivers on Seth Curry Trade:

“I clearly like Seth as a human being - I let him marry my daughter. More importantly, I guess the good thing for me is I get to see my granddaughter, which is even better.”

Doc Rivers on Seth Curry, Nov 22, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Seth Curry, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“They’re all doing great. Luka’s doing great, [Kristaps Porzingis] is doing great, Tim Hardaway [Jr.] is doing great. Seth Curry is doing terrific. Some of these guys had some little aches and pain when we entered into the hiatus... A lot of them have been able to heal up from that stuff.”

Rick Carlisle on Seth Curry, Kristaps Porzingis, Jul 5, 2020. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Markieff Morris, Seth Curry
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Markieff Morris tugging on Seth Curry’s shorts on the final play of Monday’s game:

“I didn’t like it. Didn’t like it, but you learn from it and move on.”

Scott Brooks on Markieff Morris, Seth Curry, Oct 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Josh McRoberts, Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Rick Carlisle on injured Mavericks like Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith, Josh McRoberts:

“We’re still hoping to get some guys back at some point. We’re just not sure what month. I’ve been wrong so far. Not December.”

Rick Carlisle on Josh McRoberts, Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith, Dec 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Seth Curry
item.description:
Mark Cuban on Seth Curry:

“I don’t know what team his brother is playing on. I haven’t paid much attention to the rest of his family.”

Mark Cuban on Seth Curry, Mar 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Seth Curry
item.description:
Dwain Price:Mark Cuban on #Mavs G Seth Curry:

“I don't know what team his brother plays on. I haven't paid much attention to the rest of his family.”

Mark Cuban on Seth Curry, Mar 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Seth Curry
item.description:
Dwain Price:Dirk Nowitzki on Seth Curry:

“I’m a Seth fan. I didn’t quite know what to expect, but he’s a lot quicker than I thought.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Seth Curry, Oct 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.
